title: Neurotic Manipulations
subtitle: Ductilis — the nerve of blood
text: Ductilis carries coordination through blood: nerve, current and command. Deadly Gaze (CHARGED) lifts what you look at, and a full charge slams it down. Activation Potential (CHARGED) charges a radial discharge that interrupts what it hits; water, iron and copper carry the current. Synaptic Jolt (QUICK) shocks one target and interrupts it, and held it jumps to water, iron, copper or your own Ferric constructs and keeps the whole run live, or jolts a creature each pulse. Conductive Mark (QUICK) marks a target that allied Ductilis, Lux and Ferric hits arc from. Hemolymphal Pulse (QUICK) reveals the blood-bearing bodies round you. Sanguine Ward (CONTINUOUS) channels a sheath that eats harm and jolts attackers. Hematic Rebuke (QUICK) jolts a creature's nerves so it drops its target and flees; Hematic Impressment (QUICK) leashes its nerves to yours so it defends you for a time. Sanguine Marionette (CONTINUOUS) channels a tether that drives one blood-bearing mob. Thread Ripper (CHARGED) cuts an aimed tether: a captive, a puppet, a summoned or a bound creature. Living Circuit (CONTINUOUS) links nearby teammates with travelling impulses, Sovereign Instinct (PASSIVE) turns a crowd's attackers on one another, and Synaptic Storm (CHARGED) chains lightning between up to eight enemies. At Degree Six, Axonal Transduction (PASSIVE; woven only at a Somatic Loom raised to its second stage) turns the practitioner into a living impulse. Weave a Naeglerophaeon Ganglion beside a blank Hematic Memory with four Neurotic enzymes and 600 mL blood. Absorb the memory in an Iron Brazier. Enable the passive, then touch a Synaptic Node to enter connected Nerve Fibers or Bundles. Hold forward to travel toward where you look, press backward to travel away, release to stop, and look into a branch to choose it. Sneak bypasses entry or slows travel. Another node releases you into clear space. Travel has no upkeep or time limit, but broken fibers stop the run. You cannot attack, cast, or work blocks while dissolved. Conjure Crossbow reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Crossbow.
